IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Wednesday, October 7, 2026**

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** is running hot. Sixty-two calls across three data center gigs at Port Washington, all reposted and hungry. Gurtz, Cupertino, and MJ Electric are stacking bodies at **$60.00/hr** over JW scale on 58–60 hour weeks. That's the play if you want velocity and tonnage—the overtime is baked in, and nobody's waiting around.

**LU-474 Memphis, TN** is the per diem goldmine. Nine calls but Cache Valley and ArchKey Sachs are moving fast on Memphis and West Memphis data center work. ArchKey's Google job runs 6/10s with double-time OT and a **$250/day attendance bonus**—that's real money on top of scale, and they're starting immediately.

**LU-583 El paso, TX** is the remote pay leader. Twenty calls at Santa Teresa, New Mexico: Cupertino and B&D both posting **$70.00/hr**, but here's the hook—Cupertino throws down **$1121.00/week per diem** for workers 350+ miles out. That's not chump change. All OT double time after 40. Book's thin at 77 hands, so you slot in fast.

**LU-26 Washington, DC** sits fat with eighty-two calls, mostly data center work across Manassas and Mineral, Virginia. JE Richards dominates the board with 109 positions on the MDC Manassas data center—M–F 5/8s with 2 hours OT daily plus Saturday. No posted scale, but the volume is legit and consistent.

**LU-237 Niagara Falls, NY** is specialized work. Ferguson Electric's Lake Mariner data center call at **$48.20/hr** runs 7/10s Monday through Sunday with per diem incentives, first shift 6:30 AM start. Only seven calls total on the board, but it's solid, predictable schedule.

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** is pharma heavy—Eli Lilly K153 and Lebanon plants, **$53.90–$54.75/hr** range on temperature control and new construction. Thirty-four calls, ninety-six hands. Background checks are tight; OSHA 10 required. Work's real and institutional.

The trend is obvious: data centers and specialized industrial are consuming hands faster than traditional construction. Remote work commands the per diem premium now—pack your bags and chase the West.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Wednesday, October 7, 2026**

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** is running the hottest single calls on the board right now. Cupertino Electric's Santa Teresa inside JW work is sitting at **$70/hr** with **$1121.00/week per diem** for travelers 350+ miles out — that's data center heavy, NM license locked, but the money's real. B&D Industries has 10 more inside JW slots at the same **$70/hr** on Project Miner, fire alarm experience a plus. This is specialized industrial work, not commodity lineman jobs, and it shows in the rate.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** has 18 live calls with 66 hands needed — solid board. Pierce Powerline's 7 journeyman slots on metro storm restoration are **$46.80/hr** with **$125/day per diem**, OH&UG experienced only. Fairway Electric onboards 10/8 with 4 more journeyman calls at **$46.80/hr** and **$150/day**. Service Electric and Inception are running substation tech work at **$44.46/hr** across statewide calls — core utility work, not spike jobs.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** has 17 calls for 44 hands — data center money. Parsons' Polaris Forge inside JW work is **$44.80/hr** with **$100/day non-taxed per diem** (weekends **$150**), ND license required. Michels Power's compressor station gig in St. Vincent pays **$44.80/hr** with **$200/day per diem** — that's the real incentive. Both are industrial, not transmission, but the overnight money is serious.

**LU-245 Toledo, OH** sits at 15 calls with 31 hands. MJ Electric's 345kV lattice work near Fort Wayne runs **$56.66/hr** with **$100/day + room** or **$175/day solo**, CDL A manual required. Didado's transmission and distribution in Oak Harbor offers **$225/day per diem** on their 6 JL calls — pure OT leverage for travelers.

**LU-66 Houston, TX** has 13 journeyman lineman calls and 8 transmission tech slots but no pay posted yet — watch this board for rate drops once NHPL and MP Technologies clarify. Class A CDL locked across all calls.

The market's bifurcating: specialty industrial (data centers, substations) is paying top dollar in remote zones; core utility work is steady but flat. Data center build-out is pulling hands north and west.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Wednesday, October 7, 2026**

**LU-208 Denver, CO**
Two calls but solid depth on one: Kiewit's running a crew on an unspecified project at **$65.00/hr** for a CWI position, 5-10s with an 8-hour Saturday, night shift. That's the board's standout rate. Power Source Services is also hiring combo welders with rigging cert or rigging experience for the JM Shafer station in Fort Lupton—no rate posted yet, but the work's live. Around 10 hands needed across both.

**LU-213 St John, NB**
Three calls, three hands needed, and dispatch isn't showing rates yet—common on the Canadian boards early in the posting. Lake Utopia Paper in Lorneville has two separate calls: one F3/F4 welder position testing Carbon Stick and Tig, one Journeyman Pipefitter on 4x10s plus. LNG Lorneville also has a Journeyman Pipefitter slot on the same schedule. Thin board but solid industrial ag work if you can get north.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY**
PMI's got one call at Fort Meade VA Hospital in Sturgis, South Dakota—a UA-21 Welder slot with **$100/day per diem** for days worked. Requires OSHA 10 and a clean background. Single hand needed; single call. Medical facility work, stable project likely.

The small boards are moving hands faster than the deep ones—when you've got three calls and three hands, that's zero depth. Colorado and Wyoming are pulling welders and pipefitters into industrial and utility work; Canada's holding steady on process piping. Rates stay soft until the seasonal push hits hard in November.
